title: Inherited property faces £120,000 tax bill under reforms
summary:
Property owners could face tax bills of nearly £120,000 on inherited homes under proposed capital gains tax reforms, according to analysis from Rathbones. The research examines the removal of CGT uplift on death and alignment of rates with income tax bands.

The post Inherited property faces £120,000 tax bill under reforms appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Stamp duty costs deter homeowners from moving, data shows
summary:
Stamp duty costs are preventing homeowners from moving, according to analysis from property portal Zoopla, with bills reaching five figures across southern England. Regional data shows average costs of £20,000 in London compared to £2,200 in northern regions.

title: Winkworth appoints Oracle Group for national PR strategy
summary:
Estate agency franchise Winkworth has appointed The Oracle Group to manage its public relations and communications strategy across its UK and international operations. The appointment marks a strategic move by the London-based agency network to enhance its national profile whilst maintaining focus on the local expertise of its franchise offices.

title: Nine strategies distinguish top estate agency websites
summary:
Analysis of high-performing estate agency websites reveals nine distinct strategies that separate them from competitors. Leading sites employ specific techniques including prominent calls to action, integrated social proof, and optimised local search content to generate business independent of property portals.

title: Residential landlords shift to commercial amid tax pressures
summary:
Property investors are increasingly moving away from residential buy-to-let portfolios towards commercial property in response to mounting tax and regulatory pressures. Trade body Propertymark reports commercial agents are receiving more enquiries from residential landlords seeking to transition their investment strategies.

title: UK housing market faces muted sales for next 12 months
summary:
Estate agents should prepare for subdued transaction volumes over the next 12 months, according to the latest RICS monthly housing survey. New buyer enquiries recorded a negative net balance of -29%, while newly agreed sales remained weak at -32%.

The post UK housing market faces muted sales for next 12 months appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: First-time developer secures £2.18m for nine-flat scheme
summary:
Avamore Capital has provided a £2.18m ground-up development facility for a nine-flat residential scheme, despite the borrower having no previous construction or development experience. The transaction involved several challenges including the site's railway line location and an unconventional unit mix featuring several five-bedroom apartments.

title: Vistry expects £30m loss after discounting unsold homes
summary:
Vistry Group has announced it expects to make a £30m loss in the first half of the year after implementing significant discounts to clear unsold housing stock. The company's shares fell 8% following the announcement, which also revealed the departure of its finance director.

The post Vistry expects £30m loss after discounting unsold homes appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: AI-enhanced property photos raise transparency concerns
summary:
Estate agents are increasingly using artificial intelligence tools to digitally enhance property photographs, from repainting walls to adding non-existent lawns, raising questions about transparency in property marketing. The practice has prompted discussions among agents, viewers and trading standards experts about appropriate disclosure standards.

title: Portfolio landlord saves £280,000 on 77-property refinance
summary:
A 77-property portfolio has been refinanced through Paragon Bank's multi-property proposition, delivering an estimated £280,000 saving over five years. The transaction consolidated borrowing into a single application managed by one underwriter.
